title: Cross-Domain Bridge Equations for the EFC Framework: Connecting Cosmology, Neural Entropy, and RLHF via Dissipative Gradient-Flow Dynamics
description: Derives two formal bridge equations that connect EFC’s three tracks—cosmology, cortical entropy, and RLHF—under a single dissipative gradient-flow with a Lyapunov free energy. Bridge B1 maps cosmological entropy-production density to a neural analogue via a dimensionless effective free-energy gradient and revises the driver from global Fiedler connectivity to local degree heterogeneity. Bridge B2 identifies the neural entropy tensor with the RLHF reward-landscape curvature and sets a temperature mapping β_KL ↔ 1/T_cog, yielding three new cross-domain predictions.

free_energy_functional.description: Defines the Helmholtz free energy for an open dissipative system in terms of the entropy-production rate density.

unified_dynamics.description: Wasserstein-like gradient-flow on entropy-production fields; F is a Lyapunov functional when volume dissipation dominates boundary fluxes.

b1_effective_gradient.description: Neural analogue of the cosmological driving gradient: a dimensionless local free-energy gradient combining metabolic, synaptic, and information-flow potentials.

b1_entropy_production.description: Local neural entropy-production rate driven by the effective gradient, synaptic coupling, and information throughput.

alphaN_constraint.description: Parameter-free neural coupling constant inherited from EFC Spor 1 parameters (k, a_G) and cortical scale.

b1_starstar_degree_heterogeneity.description: Revised Bridge B1**: entropy-production ratio scales with local degree heterogeneity; replaces the non-predictive Fiedler-eigenvalue formulation.

b2_tensor_identification.description: Bridge B2 maps the neural entropy tensor to RLHF reward-landscape curvature.

b2_scalar_temperature.description: Identifies policy entropy with a normalized neural entropy and maps the RLHF KL temperature to the inverse cognitive temperature.

key_results.main_finding: A single Lyapunov gradient-flow unifies EFC’s cosmology, neural, and RLHF regimes; Bridge B1 is revised to degree-heterogeneity control of neural entropy gradients and yields a parameter-free α_N ≈ 44 K bit^{-1} m^2 s^{-1}, while Bridge B2 ties neural entropy tensors to RLHF reward curvature and β_KL to 1/T_cog.

sealed_predictions.statement: Hub-to-periphery entropy-production ratio obeys η = C_eff / D_ratio^γ with γ ∈ [0.5, 0.6] and C_eff fixed by Spor 1 (no free parameters); degree heterogeneity, not the Fiedler eigenvalue, predicts the cortical entropy gradient.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Empirical test on HCP structural connectomes paired with multiscale entropy (MSE) maps: primary threshold |r| > 0.40 (p < 0.05) for η vs D_ratio^{-γ}; strong confirmation |r| > 0.60; failure to exceed |r| = 0.40 falsifies B1**.

kill_criteria: KC1: Violations of dF/dt ≤ 0 in regimes where boundary fluxes are controlled to be negligible (i.e., volume dissipation does not dominate) for any of the three domains.
KC2: Bridge B1** fails on independent datasets: the correlation between η and D_ratio^{-γ} is |r| < 0.40 (p ≥ 0.05) using HCP SC + MSE or equivalent, across standard parcellations.
KC3: The parameter-free magnitude of α_N = k/(a_G L_cortex^3) disagrees with cortical metabolic entropy-production measurements by ≥ 10× across regions in PET/fMRI-derived estimates.

KC4: Bridge B2 temperature mapping fails: varying β_KL during RLHF training does not produce the predicted inverse relation to an effective cognitive temperature (no systematic alignment between policy entropy and 1/β_KL).

KC5: Contrary evidence that global algebraic connectivity (Fiedler λ2) reliably outperforms degree heterogeneity in predicting cortical entropy gradients across multiple cohorts would overturn the B1** revision.
abstract: Two formal bridge equations connect EFC's three tracks (cosmology, neural entropy, RLHF) via dissipative gradient-flow dynamics. Bridge B1 maps cosmological entropy-production density onto a neural analogue using local degree heterogeneity. Bridge B2 maps the neural entropy tensor onto RLHF reward-landscape curvature. Both instantiate dF/dt = -integral |nabla s_dot|^2 dV + B with dF/dt <= 0. Three new cross-domain predictions are derived.

unified_dynamics.interpretation: Gradient-flow (Wasserstein-like) dynamics; F is Lyapunov functional for all three regimes
unified_dynamics.stability_condition: dF/dt <= 0 when volume dissipation dominates boundary fluxes

neural_entropy_production.alpha_N: k / (a_G * L_cortex^3) ~ 44 K bit^-1 m^2 s^-1

revised_B1_star_star.why_revised: Fiedler eigenvalue r~0.16 (not predictive); degree ratio r~-0.97 (near-deterministic)

cross_domain_predictions.title: Entropy-production ratio from degree heterogeneity
cross_domain_predictions.formula: eta = C_eff / D_ratio^gamma; C_eff derived from Spor 1; no free parameters
cross_domain_predictions.test: HCP SC + MSE; primary: |r| > 0.40, p < 0.05; strong: |r| > 0.60

cross_domain_predictions.title: Neural temperature calibrates RLHF
cross_domain_predictions.formula: T_cog from resting-state fMRI calibrates optimal beta_KL without grid search
cross_domain_predictions.test: Calibrate RLHF beta_KL from resting-state fMRI nabla S_neural
cross_domain_predictions.falsification: Optimal beta_KL inconsistent with fMRI prediction

cross_domain_predictions.title: Entropy topology maps to reward curvature
cross_domain_predictions.formula: DMN entropy-gradient topology <-> reward landscape curvature in trained LLMs
cross_domain_predictions.test: fMRI nabla S_neural vs reward curvature in trained LLMs
cross_domain_predictions.falsification: Gradient topology uncorrelated with reward curvature

version_history.v0.1: Used Fiedler eigenvalue lambda_2 for B1; P4* prediction
version_history.v0.2: Replaced with degree ratio D_ratio (B1**); P4** prediction; DOI assigned
